title: Grid Capacity Map TSO - Production and Consumption
description:
**Replacing [GridCapacityMapTSO](https://energidataservice.dk/tso-electricity/GridCapacityMapTSO)** 

The dataset is the monthly dataset that describes the grid capacity at the TSO level, capacity at the general level, and for wind and solar production and consumption units.
comment:
Data is related to [www.kapacitetskort.dk](https://storymaps.arcgis.com/stories/eb5b387e376f49b8996d5e7c47fbdd37).

***apc**: available production capacity* \
***acc**: available consumption capacity*\
***cap**: capacity* \
***cons**: consumption* \
***su**: summer* \
***wi**: winter* \
***prod**:  production* \
***lb / ub**: lower / upper bound* \
***with_tso / no_tso**: transformer presence*
author: Energinet

Available capacity in % for connection and integration of 100 MW solar at the TSO stations in the current electricity grid. The capacity is calculated as delivered/possible yearly wind production. Values are indicative and the station values cannot be summarized. Data is related to [www.kapacitetskort.dk](https://storymaps.arcgis.com/stories/eb5b387e376f49b8996d5e7c47fbdd37).

Available capacity in % for connection and integration of 300 MW solar at the TSO stations in the current electricity grid. The capacity is calculated as delivered/possible yearly wind production.
